figures:
F1: Day 0/1/5/10 photographs and optional antibody branch; day-10 result is not total antibody-inclusive workflow time.
F2: A/C instrument schematics; B/D actual dual-channel red vascular and green TH images.
F3: A LSFM vascular display; B/C local confocal vascular display; D separate H&E comparator. Green squares denote ROIs, not TH signal.
F4: Dual-channel vascular-associated TH; representative images cannot establish a universal negative in glomeruli.
F5: Contextual outcome plots retained historically; no model construction steps extracted. Units and sample counts are panel-specific.
F6: C volume percentage, E volume fold change on axis; denominator discrepancy with caption retained.

Application.Text2:
movie_findings:
1: Merged and separate red/green rotating whole-kidney reconstruction.
2: Merged and separate red/green optical sections. A sampled black edge field does not imply missing tissue.
3: Local dual-channel confocal optical sections, green signal associated with red vascular structures.
4: Red vascular optical sections; no displayed green channel does not prove TH labeling was never performed.
5: Red vascular rotating local 3D reconstruction, glomeruli and connecting branches.
